tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_nevermore_requiem_D:
Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.

Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_nevermore_bio: It is said that Nevermore the Shadow Fiend has the soul of a poet, and in fact he has thousands of them. Over the ages he has claimed the souls of poets, priests, emperors, beggars, slaves, philosophers, criminals and (naturally) heroes; no sort of soul escapes him. What he does with them is unknown. No one has ever peered into the Abysm whence Nevermore reaches out like an eel from among astral rocks. Does he devour them one after another? Does he mount them along the halls of an eldritch temple, or pickle the souls in necromantic brine? Is he merely a puppet, pushed through the dimensional rift by a demonic puppeteer? Such is his evil, so intense his aura of darkness, that no rational mind may penetrate it. Of course, if you really want to know where the stolen souls go, there's one sure way to find out: Add your soul to his collection. Or just wait for Nevermore.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_nevermore_hype: Capturing souls from every kill he makes, Shadow Fiend is always gathering his power. Every assault, each carefully aimed raze that kills an enemy, brings him closer to unleashing his gathered souls in a deadly blast of scouring energy.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# Applies the following two buffs at the same time:
*#* {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|nevermore_frenzy}}
*#** Reapplying the buff refreshes the duration.
*#** {{cf|talnotes}} The {{ValueColor||cast animation time factor|25tal}} {{M|talent|t=t4r}} stacks multiplicatively with other cast time reduction sources.
*#* {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|nevermore_feast_of_souls_collection}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*#** Centered on Nevermore upon cast for the entire duration.
*#** Considers the following enemy units valid:
*#*** Considers {{M|clones}} and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as heroes, other {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
*#*** {{M|Lane creeps}} and {{M|neutral creeps}}.
*#*** {{M|Untargetable}} units.
*#** Does not consider the following enemy units valid:
*#*** The ability can affect the same enemy units once per cast. Hence, units already considered by {{A|Shadow Fiend|Feast of Souls}} are not valid.
*#*** {{M|Fogged units}}.
*#*** {{M|Hidden}} units.
*#*** {{M|Illusions}}
*#*** {{M|Invisible}} units.
*#*** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
*#** Grants {{#var:Feast of Souls type1 value6}} ({{Symbol|bonus t2l}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Feast of Souls type1 value6 tal}}|15tal}}) {{A|Shadow Fiend|Necromastery}} stacks per valid enemy hero within the radius in {{#var:Feast of Souls type1 value2}}-second intervals, starting {{#var:Feast of Souls type1 value2}} seconds upon cast, and requires {{calc|floor(v1/{{#var:Feast of Souls type1 value6}})+1|v1={{#var:Feast of Souls type1 value3}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t2l}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|floor(v1/{{#var:Feast of Souls type1 value6 tal}})+1|v1={{#var:Feast of Souls type1 value3}}}}|15tal}}) valid enemy units to reach max stacks.
*# {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|nevermore_feast_of_souls_linger}}
*#* The additional granted {{A|Shadow Fiend|Necromastery}} stacks lingers {{#var:Feast of Souls type3 value1}} seconds after casting the ability.
*# {{Symbol|Modifier|Stack}}
*#* Reduces the {{A|Shadow Fiend|Necromastery}} stacks corresponding to the current units alive upon losing this debuff in any way.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_nevermore
data.bio_loc: It is said that Nevermore the Shadow Fiend has the soul of a poet, and in fact he has thousands of them. Over the ages he has claimed the souls of poets, priests, emperors, beggars, slaves, philosophers, criminals and (naturally) heroes; no sort of soul escapes him. What he does with them is unknown. No one has ever peered into the Abysm whence Nevermore reaches out like an eel from among astral rocks. Does he devour them one after another? Does he mount them along the halls of an eldritch temple, or pickle the souls in necromantic brine? Is he merely a puppet, pushed through the dimensional rift by a demonic puppeteer? Such is his evil, so intense his aura of darkness, that no rational mind may penetrate it. Of course, if you really want to know where the stolen souls go, there's one sure way to find out: Add your soul to his collection. Or just wait for Nevermore.
data.hype_loc: Capturing souls from every kill he makes, Shadow Fiend is always gathering his power. Every assault, each carefully aimed raze that kills an enemy, brings him closer to unleashing his gathered souls in a deadly blast of scouring energy.
data.npe_desc_loc: Unleashes the souls of fallen enemies for damage

notes_loc: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.

abilities.desc_loc:
Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for %duration% seconds. For the duration of the effect, every %soul_collection_interval%s he collects souls from %soul_collection_per_interval% enemies in a %soul_collection_radius% radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for %linger_duration%s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.

 Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.
abilities.lore_loc: For Nevermore, there's as much delight in the harvest as there is in the feast.

abilities.name: nevermore_dark_lord
abilities.desc_loc: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.
abilities.lore_loc: Even being near Nevermore eats away at one's soul.
notes_loc: Stacks fully with other armor reduction abilities and aura.
facets_loc: Presence of the Dark Lord temporarily reduces more armor after nearby enemy heroes are killed.

abilities.name: nevermore_requiem
abilities.desc_loc:
Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.

Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
abilities.lore_loc: The captured souls of those past slain are released to ravage their former allies.
notes_loc: One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every %requiem_soul_conversion% soul in his possession.
Fear and movement slow do not apply if the Requiem was released on death.
abilities.scepter_loc: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.

abilities.name: nevermore_necromastery
abilities.desc_loc: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining %necromastery_damage_per_soul% bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant %souls_per_hero_kill% souls. On death, he releases %soul_release_tooltip%%% of them from bondage.
abilities.lore_loc: Harvested souls swirl in and out of the Abysm, empowering the Shadow Fiend to increase the size of his collection.
notes_loc: Denies and neutral creeps also provide bonus damage through Necromastery.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
facets_loc: Every hero kill increases max souls by %max_soul_increase_on_hero_kill% until Shadow Fiend dies.
